newsitem.title: UK: LME copper little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper little changed in late trading.

text.p: Copper prices stayed shy of the $2,200 resistance level in late inter-office trade on the London Metal Exchange on Friday.
Three-months futures were indicated at $2,192/$2195 at 1900 GMT, little changed from the afternoon kerb close of $2,193, which was up $16 from Thursday.
Profit taking and end-week book squaring helped pare copper's gains from the day's high of $2,208, traders said, after an unexpected drawdown in LME stocks bolstered values earlier in the day.
Still, copper was looking healthier on the charts and could tackle the nearby $2,215 resistance level next week if stock drawdowns continued, analysts said.
Other base metals were also little changed from the kerb close. Aluminium eased $2 to $1,552/$1,554, with the $1,570 level seen providing stiff resistance.
